failure_summary.description: T1 and T5 re-filtered cached flight keys for 'business' instead of first-searching the requested hotel (T5 also loaded a missing 'hotels' key and used the invented kwarg has_free_wifi_included). T2 treated 'Yes' to 'any other Social attractions?' as a hotel num_people refilter instead of a fresh attraction search.
T6 and T8 wrote search_attractions(city="AZ"/"GA") instead of state=, despite several existing rules.
T7 searched hotels with May 16/18, 2025 (copied from a skill example) when no dates were given, and dropped the requested restaurant search plus the closing seek_information.
T4 answered a date-range reply with seek_information (and asked for hotel dates nobody requested) instead of two flight searches.
T3 mapped a nightshade allergy to has_gluten_free_options; gold uses has_tomato_allergy_options.

patch.reasoning: These edits target the failures that recur across the batch and add little text. (1) A short top-of-skill line for the state= vs city= trap (2 of 8 failures, despite deeper rules) plus a restaurant allergy-flag mapping. (2) A scope clarification on the SEARCH GATE, which currently pushes the model to filter whenever any key exists. A requested domain with no key must be searched, and 'Yes' to a new attraction type is a fresh search; the slow block already says this but the top rule contradicts it. (3) A fix to the Rule 7 example that primes seek_information even after the user has given dates. (4) Removal of the literal example dates in the St. Louis example, which the model copied into a no-date hotel search. No FLIGHT REPLIES (-1) block or 'only new constraints' wording is touched, since edits there were rejected in earlier steps.

edits.target: ## HARD OUTPUT RULES (check before EVERY response)
edits.content: - KWARG TRAPS: (a) A state name or two-letter code ('Social attractions in AZ', 'a trip to GA', 'Georgia') is `state="AZ"`; `city="AZ"` or `city="GA"` is always wrong. Use city= only for a real city name. (b) Restaurant allergy words each have their own flag: nightshade or tomato -> has_tomato_allergy_options=True, dairy -> has_dairy_allergy_options, nut -> has_nut_allergy_options, shellfish -> has_shell_fish_allergy_options, gluten -> has_gluten_free_options. Never substitute a different flag.

GATE SCOPE: the gate is per domain. (i) A domain requested anywhere in the conversation but with NO key (for example a hotel asked for in turn 1 and never searched, while only flight keys exist) is searched now, using the city and dates already in the conversation. A stay of 'N nights' means `adjust_date` from the known start date, and a solo trip means num_people=1. Cached flight keys are NOT re-filtered for a class their summary already lists, and a reply like 'don't need a return flight' adds no flight action. Never load a key that is not literally in CACHE. (ii) 'Yes' to an assistant offer of ANOTHER attraction type ('any other Social attractions?') is a fresh `search_attractions(city=<trip city>, type=["<offered type>"])` saved under a new key such as attractions_2. It is not a filter, and not a hotel party-size refilter.

edits.target: A flight-only opener with origin and destination ('large group booking from Atlanta to Tucson for a school trip') -> ask only for the departure date, and do not add hotel dates because no hotel was requested.
edits.content: A flight-only opener with origin and destination and NO date yet ('large group booking from Atlanta to Tucson for a school trip') -> ask only for the departure date, and do not add hotel dates because no hotel was requested. Once the user answers with a date or an 'X to Y' range, never ask again: write the two flight searches of Rule 9 (departure_flights and return_flights), and a hotel search only if a hotel was requested.
